cards.text: Archie has pushed two benches together and set a Tesco meal deal at each place. Owen has been given a chair again.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Board meeting. Every Monday, catering provided." He taps his sandwich. "Each of us pitches a goal and we argue it out in front of you. Then you pick which one we chase this week."

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "Next Monday I read the minutes and we find out whether you chose well. We'll argue. You decide. Nobody is wounded if it isn't theirs."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Worst you'll get is 'next week, then'. Then I pitch again, louder."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "You're getting poached, Owen. Different department. Start Friday." James does not look up. "He is not."
